validation.typeChecks: Playground all modes and installed npm NodeNext/Bundler positive/negative and browser without Node ambient types

limitations: Physical audio device and hardware-fidelity listening were not tested. Browser physical outputs were muted; Native browser RPC was mocked.
LFO uses the retained gain/wave tables and a corrected oscillator/reset adapter; this is not a hardware comparison.
SDK, parent application and Tauri are separate Git repositories with uncommitted changes.
Existing npm 0.2.35 and older release ZIPs were retained; no npm/SDK/GitHub publication, commit or push was performed.
